Explanation

The following SSL certificates have failed renewal attempts detected in the Let's Encrypt logs. This could indicate:

  • DNS issues preventing domain validation
  • Firewall blocking Let's Encrypt verification servers
  • Webserver configuration issues
  • Rate limiting from Let's Encrypt

Recommended Actions

  • Check the full Let's Encrypt logs on the server: /var/log/letsencrypt/letsencrypt.log
  • Verify DNS records are pointing correctly to your server
  • Ensure port 80 and 443 are accessible from the internet
  • Check if you've hit Let's Encrypt rate limits
  • Try manually renewing certificates using the SSL tab for each affected site
